units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:3">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ותְיַיחֵד לבבינו וכ׳</he> and concentrate our hearts (inclinations) to fear thy Name.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:11">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>אברהם י׳ … שמו עליו</he> on Abraham did the Lord confer His Name (<cite ref="Genesis 26:24">Gen. XXVI, 24</cite>, a. e.).

<cite ref="Genesis 26:24">Ib.</cite> <he>ידע שהקב״ה מְיַחֵד שמו עליו</he> he inferred that the Lord would confer His Name upon him (to be called ‘the God of Jacob’). Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 <he>על ישראל י׳ שמו ביותר</he> (although the Lord of the universe) He conferred His Name particularly on Israel (v. <cite ref="J00255"><he>יוֹתֵר</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to declare the unity of God, to recite Sh’ma (Deut. VI, 4).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אנו … ומְיַחֲדִים שמו וכ׳</he> we trust in Him and profess His unity &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:1">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>ואני מְיַחֶדֶת שמו וכ׳</he> and I (Israel) profess the unity of His name twice every day, (saying) Hear, O Israel &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 57a:23">Snh. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>שיי׳ שפחה לעבדו</he> who designated a handmaid (as a wife) for his slave.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <he>ויי׳ אליו הדבור וכ׳</he> addressed the command to him exclusively (<cite ref="Leviticus 10:8">Lev. X, 8</cite>); a. e.—

Yoma 11ᵇ (ref. to Lev. XIV, 35) מי שמְיַיחֵד ביתו לו וכ׳ he who devotes his household exclusively to himself, and is unwilling to lend his vessels &c.; Arakh. 16ᵃ שמיוחד (v. infra); Yalk. Lev. 564.—5) to leave persons alone in a special room, to arrange a private meeting for.

Keth. 12ᵃ; Tosef. ib. I, 4; Y. ib. I, 25ᵃ bot. היו מְיַיחֲדִין וכ׳ they used to leave bride and groom in a private room alone for a while.—Part. pass. מְיוּחָד, f. מְיוּחֶדֶת; pl. מְיוּחָדִים, מְיוּחָדִין, מְיוּחָדוֹת
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60a">Snh. 60ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שם המי׳</he> the proper Name of the Lord (Jehovah).—

Yoma 11ᵃ ביתך ביתך המי׳ לך ‘thy house’ (Deut. VI, 9; XI, 20), thy house which is designated for thy personal use. Ib.ᵇ מה בית מ׳ לדירה bayith means a room designated for a dwelling, יצאו אלו שאינן מי׳ לדירה to the exclusion of those rooms (gate lodge &c.) which are not designated for dwellings. Arakh. l. c. מי׳ לו devoted to his own exclusive use, v. supra; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite>, end (ref. to <he>כאחד</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:16">Gen. XLIX, 16</cite>) <he>כמי׳ שבשבטים</he> like the most distinguished among the tribes.

<cite ref="Yevamot 62a">Yeb. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>אני שמ׳ לדבור בכל וכ׳</he> I (Moses) who am singled out (must be prepared) for divine communication every hour; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2">Ab. d’R. N., II</cite> Vers., ch. II (ed. Schechter, p. 10) <he>שאני כלי מי׳</he> who am a special vessel (of revelation).
<cite ref="Meilah 15a">Meïl. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>קדשים המי׳ לה׳</he> sanctified things which are exclusively dedicated to the Lord; Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 11, ch. XX.—
<cite ref="Meilah 15a">Ib.</cite> Sh’mini, ch. II, Par. 2 <he>כבשים ועזים המי׳</he> lambs and goats which are specified (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:4">Deut. XIV, 4</cite>); a. fr.—

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>בזמן שהאשה מי׳ עם וכ׳</he> when a wife is locked up with her husband.

units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 7">Ex. R. s. 7</cite> <he>היה ראוי … להִתְיַיחֵד עליו וכ׳</he> the divine communication was to bear his name alone.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <he>נתי׳ אליו הדבור</he> the divine communication was addressed to him especially; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be alone with, to be closeted with.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:12">Kidd. IV, 12</cite> <he>לא יִתְיַיחֵד אדם וכ׳</he> a man must not be alone (even) with two women, but one woman <he>מִתְיַיחֶדֶת וכ׳</he> may be alone with two men.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:1">Ab. Zar. II, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 7:4">Tosef. Gitt. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:4">V</cite>), 4; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="J00270"><he>יִחוּד</he></cite>.
